testCases.name: Multi-stage Build Structure

input.check: Verify multi-stage build with metabob-cli-builder, opencode-binary, and runtime stages

testCases.validationLogic: Count FROM...AS statements, verify stage names match specification
testCases.importance: CRITICAL - Multi-stage build is the foundation of clean environment

testCases.name: No Source Code in Runtime Stage

input.check: Verify runtime stage contains NO COPY commands for source code (repos/, .ts files, /workspace)

testCases.validationLogic: Parse runtime stage, check all COPY commands use --from=builder or copy only config files
testCases.importance: CRITICAL - Prevents source code leakage, enforces intellectual property protection

testCases.name: Bootstrap Templates Copied

input.check: Verify bootstrap templates are copied to /metabob-proto/activities/bootstrap/

testCases.validationLogic: Check for COPY repos/metabob-proto/activities/bootstrap and mkdir -p commands
testCases.importance: CRITICAL - Without bootstrap templates, container crashes on startup

testCases.name: Build Script Dockerfile Reference

input.check: Verify build script uses docker/Dockerfile.devbob (production) not configs/Dockerfile.devbob (dev)

testCases.validationLogic: Check docker build -f flag points to docker/Dockerfile.devbob
testCases.importance: HIGH - Prevents accidental builds with development Dockerfile

testCases.name: Unconditional Activity Execution

input.check: Verify configure-vessel-for-environment activity runs unconditionally (not conditional on BACKEND_READY)

testCases.validationLogic: Check activity execution is not wrapped in if BACKEND_READY condition, verify backend_available variable is passed
testCases.importance: CRITICAL - Enforces self-sufficiency, container must configure itself without backend

testCases.name: Validation Template Clean Environment

input.check: Verify validation template tests for clean binary deployment (NO source code) instead of source code existence

testCases.validationLogic: Check for verify-clean-binary-deployment task, verify no git status checks in /workspace
testCases.importance: MEDIUM - Ensures validation tests match architecture

testCases.name: Container Runtime Clean Environment
testCases.validationLogic: Start container, exec find commands, verify zero results for source code, verify components exist
testCases.importance: CRITICAL - Final runtime verification of clean environment

phase1_static_analysis.description: Parse Dockerfile, scripts, templates to verify configuration

phase2_runtime_verification.description: Build container, start it, exec commands to verify clean environment

constraint1_standaloneBinary.validates: Only standalone binary at /usr/local/bin/opencode, no source code

constraint2_metabobCliVenv.validates: Only venv at /opt/metabob-cli/.venv, no pip, no source

constraint4_runtimeDeps.validates: Only runtime dependencies (git, python3, bun, ca-certificates)

constraint6_noReposDirectory.validates: NO repos/ directory anywhere in container

constraint8_noWorkspaceSource.validates: NO workspace source code in container

constraint9_minimalSize.validates: Multi-stage build discards all source code

constraint10_explicitDocumentation.validates: Dockerfile comments state 'NO source code' principle
